_note: Names in SLUS_002.55, the shell the BIOS boots. Its own address space: it loads at 0x80010000 and is the only executable that does.

0x80010000.name: exe_names
0x80010000.evidence: three NUL-terminated paths at the very start of the text section: cdrom:END.EXE;1, cdrom:GAME.EXE;1, cdrom:OPEN.EXE;1

0x8001024c.name: exe_name_table
0x8001024c.evidence: three pointers into exe_names, in the order OPEN, GAME, END; shell_main indexes it by next_exe and hands the result to Load

0x80010260.name: next_index
0x80010260.evidence: the word at $gp+0 that shell_main indexes exe_name_table with; zero in the file, which is why the disc boots into OPEN.EXE

0x80010264.name: next_index_ptr
0x80010264.evidence: the word at $gp+4, holding 0x800102f0; shell_main reads the byte through it after every Exec returns

0x8001026c.name: exec_header
0x8001026c.evidence: the EXEC structure Load fills and Exec runs; shell_main zeroes its +0x20 and +0x24 (stack address and size) so the overlay keeps the current stack

0x800102f0.name: next_exe
0x800102f0.evidence: the byte shell_main reads after Exec returns and uses as the index into exe_name_table: 0 OPEN, 1 GAME, 2 END. Written by OPEN.EXE through its own $gp+0 pointer and by GAME.EXE at 0x80015000. Survives an overlay because the shell lives at 0x80010000 and the overlays load at 0x80011000

0x800102f8.name: overlay_arg
0x800102f8.evidence: cleared by shell_main at startup; OPEN.EXE keeps its address in $s7 for the whole of open_main and branches on it, GAME.EXE writes it beside next_exe. The overlays' argument to each other

0x800102fa.name: overlay_arg2
0x800102fa.evidence: the second such byte, kept in $s6 by open_main; open_main stores the title menu's choice into it before returning to the shell

0x80010038.name: shell_main
0x80010038.evidence: SetMem(2), CdRemove, CdInit, then forever: Load(exe_name_table[next_index], exec_header) until it returns 1, CdRemove, EnterCriticalSection, Exec, then next_index = *next_exe and CdInit again

0x80010120.name: entry_point
0x80010120.evidence: SLUS_002.55 header; zeroes 0x80010268..0x800102a8, sets $sp from the table at 0x800101cc and $gp to 0x80010260, calls InitHeap and then shell_main
